_notes: Single source for tooltips, the glossary on /learn and the learning API. Terms used by the tutorials and missions.

terms.short: A tiny slice of a player. Its price moves as the market decides what they're worth.
HoopStreet's play money. You start with 100,000. It's not real, so be brave.
The best price someone will pay right now. You sell at the bid.
The best price someone will sell for right now. You buy at the ask.
The gap between bid and ask. A small toll you pay every time you trade.
What the market thinks a player is really worth, based on how they actually play.
Buy or sell right now at the best available price. Fast, no haggling.
A small cut (0.10%) taken on every trade. Lots of tiny trades add up.
Profit you've locked in by selling. Money in the bank.
Profit on shares you still hold. It can still vanish if the price drops.
A run of big games. Prices often jump - and the hype often fades a bit afterwards.
How jumpy a price is. High volatility = stormy weather on the ticker.
HOOP you haven't spent. Buying uses it up, selling brings it back.
Cash plus what all your shares are worth right now. Your real score.
A trader who always quotes a price to buy and a price to sell. Three of them stand behind every player.
The extra you pay when a big order eats through the best price and fills at worse ones.
An order with your price on it. It waits until the market comes to you, and never pays more than your limit.
A safety net: it sells your shares automatically if the bid falls to the price you set.
How far the price sits above fair value. Hype gaps tend to close.
A headline that hints trouble is coming. Storms usually follow within a few market minutes.
The weather icon next to a player: calm, cloudy after a warning, stormy when bad news lands.
One bar on the chart: where the price opened, closed, and how high and low it went in that time.
Spreading your HOOP across players and teams, so one bad night can't sink you.
Betting a price will fall: sell shares you've borrowed now, buy them back later. Losses have no ceiling.
Trading with borrowed HOOP. 3x leverage triples your gains and your losses.
When losses on a leveraged or short position get too big, it's closed for you at a loss.
